title: Autopilot pauses during integrate or e2e and resumes afterward
acceptance: Autopilot pauses while the orchestrator integrates or runs e2e, and resumes after.

title: Apply integrated snapshot into dependent worker workspaces before run
acceptance: A job that depends on an earlier integrated run receives a snapshot of the integrated tree automatically.
No orchestrator needs a local wip branch or a hand test run to pass state to a worker.

title: Extract scope commands from swarm.mjs into swarm-scope module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Extract lane routing and doctor paths into swarm-lanes module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Wire ticket path validation into scope split --ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses a ticket whose files or context name a path missing from the repo.
The refusal message names the closest real path for each missing path.

title: Use precise sensitive tagging during split ingest instead of scope phrase match
acceptance: scope split --ingest leaves sensitive false on a store-wrapper ticket that does not touch auth or customer data.
A ticket that writes a public API route is marked sensitive.

title: Wire delete and rename ticket sync checks into scope sync integrated path
acceptance: swarm scope sync --integrated marks a delete-only ticket done when declared files are absent.
A rename ticket is refused until the old path is gone and the new path exists.

title: Wire risk-based review batching into scope sync review manifests
acceptance: swarm scope sync --integrated requests batched Haiku reviews for small low-risk tickets.

title: Wire verify mode local into swarm run manifest dispatch
acceptance: swarm run uses verify.mode local to execute tests with agent none before lane dispatch.

title: Wire adaptive worker tuning into lane scheduler and machineConcurrency
acceptance: swarm run respects adaptive machineConcurrency from lanes.mjs under synthetic pressure.

title: Wire orchestrator handoff into swarm CLI and resume path
acceptance: swarm orchestrator handoff runs from the project root and names the saved handoff checkpoint.

title: E2e harness cleans up local test data after each run
acceptance: E2e runs clean up their own local test data, and a local-only cleanup tool refuses non-localhost databases.

title: Turn each new failure cause into a regression test stub
acceptance: Each new failure cause becomes a regression test, and lane pass rates feed routing.
